title: Aspirin Dose and Atherosclerosis in Patients With Heart Disease

sections.abstract:
The purpose of the study is to test higher versus lower doses of aspirin on markers of atherosclerosis in patients who have had a heart attack.

Posted outcomes: Change in Nitric Oxide Formation From Baseline to 3 Months.. timeframe=Baseline to 3 Months (90-97 days). 1 of 5 Randomized Treatment Arms=10.0 (±4.1); 2 of 5 Randomized Treatment Arms=11.2 (±2.8); 3 of 5 Randomized Treatment Arms=10.0 (±2.3)
